title: 第10章 落霞山脉第11章 苦战
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
经过三天三夜的生死搏斗，七彩吞天蟒和八银地熊都已经奄奄一息了，此时吞天蟒紧紧的缠住八银地熊，八银地熊紧紧的咬住吞天蟒蟒头下面的部位，谁也无法动一下。
叶辰几人看了整整三天的精彩搏斗，甚是兴奋，尤其是现在看着两头妖兽即将面临死亡，不得不说气运爆棚！三阶妖兽恐怕要一万金币起步了，三阶妖兽体内开始孕育内丹了
终于两头妖兽都失去了生命力！几人迅速的将妖兽收起来.
“我们到前面的山洞看看，几人拨开遮挡着绿草藤蔓，洞口仅有三尺左右，只能一个一个的进，几人进入山洞，瞬间感到威压，这里面灵气这么浓郁，在这里修炼肯定速度特别快，走我们去前面看看，山洞倒也不是特别的深，大概走了半个时辰就到了一处方圆百里的一座灵液池
池中央有一颗果树，看不清楚
“走，我们去看看”玉鸳鸯说道
“走”
“走”
……
灵液池深度及腰，众人艰难的走到了果树跟前
“这是玄元果，一颗玄元果可以提升金丹境一重天”叶辰惊叹道
“正好有7颗”我们每人一颗
叶辰拿出了玉盒每人送了一个
玉鸳鸯笑道“叶辰，你很有经验啊！提前准备了玉盒”
叶辰不好意思的笑了笑，把玉盒封好，保存在纳戒中，可以保存100药效不失
杜小雨，和柳嫣然用的是储物袋，其他几人则都是使用纳戒
我们在这里修炼几日吧！这么多灵液也带不走
众人也无可奈何，各自盘膝修炼
叶辰这次修炼了两天顺利突破淬体境七重天，混沌珠这次有充足的灵液可以吸收，一刻不停的吸收着，趁着大家在此修炼，叶辰没有停止修炼，叶辰有前世的感悟，境界提成没有任何的瓶颈，只要有能量就能提升，叶辰没打算停下来，马力全开
过了半个月，秦梦瑶和李元霸晋升到了炼气境，玉鸳鸯，秦逸尘，柳嫣然到了淬体境九重天，叶辰和杜小雨到了淬体境八重天

混沌珠现在有方圆百里的空间了
灵液下降了多一半
玉鸳鸯聪明伶俐，一下子就猜到了叶辰有古怪，按理大家修炼消耗不了这么多的灵液，私底下问道“叶辰，你吸收的灵液很多吧！”
叶辰正要反驳，
玉鸳鸯又低语道“你不用反驳，我也不会说出去的”神秘一笑。
叶辰面色平静，荣辱不惊，也不再解释。其他几人则满脸的疑惑，但也没人说什么
“走吧，已经出来半个多月了”玉鸳鸯带头说道
众人依次退出了山洞。柳嫣然则紧跟着叶辰。
玉鸳鸯清纯可爱，对叶辰也有点喜欢，毕竟是个小屁孩，也没那么多心思，但多少有点醋意
秦梦瑶则见怪不怪依旧那么冷艳，风轻云淡
柳嫣然在敢爱敢恨，喜欢就是喜欢，加上英雄救美，怎么能不走进心里
众人小心翼翼的走了两天，叶辰剩下的四坛酒分着喝光了
一路上基本上也躲开了二阶妖兽，一阶妖兽基本上都处理了，采了上百株一阶灵药
前面就快到了，大家加把劲，到了洞口，今晚休息一晚上，养足精神，明日我们进入洞府
翌日，众人来到一峡谷，迷雾弥漫，只见两层悬崖峭壁高耸入云。
“上次逃命，偶然逃进了迷雾，大概进入十里，就被什么东西挡住了，然后我就靠着悬崖峭壁边缘行走，不远处就有一个山洞，有块巨石封住洞口”杜小雨给众人说明情况
content_en:
After three days and three nights of life-and-death struggle, both the Colorful Sky-Swallowing Python and the Eight-Yin Earth Bear were already dying. At this time, the Sky-Swallowing Python was tightly wrapped around the Eight-Yin Earth Bear, and the Eight-Yin Earth Bear was biting the part below the head of the Sky-Swallowing Python so tightly that no one could move.
Ye Chen and others watched the exciting fight for three whole days and were very excited, especially now that the two monsters were about to die, they had to say that they were very lucky! A third-level monster will probably cost 10,000 gold coins to start, and the inner elixir of the third-level monster will begin to grow in its body.
Finally, both monsters lost their vitality! Several people quickly put away the monster.
"Let's go to the cave in front to have a look. A few people pushed aside the green grass and vines. The entrance to the cave is only about three feet long. They can only enter one by one. A few people entered the cave and felt pressure instantly. The spiritual energy in the cave is so rich. The speed of practicing here must be very fast. Let's go to the front to take a look. The cave is not particularly deep. After walking for about half an hour, we arrived at a pool of spiritual liquid that is a hundred miles around.
There is a fruit tree in the middle of the pond. You can't see clearly.
"Let's go and take a look," Yu Yuanyang said.
"go"
"go"
…
The pool of spiritual liquid was as deep as the waist, and everyone walked to the fruit tree with difficulty.
"This is the Xuanyuan Fruit. One Xuanyuan Fruit can elevate you to the first level of the Golden Core Realm." Ye Chen exclaimed.
"There are exactly 7" one for each of us
Ye Chen took out the jade box and gave one to each person.
Yu Yuanyang smiled and said, "Ye Chen, you are very experienced! I prepared the jade box in advance”
Ye Chen smiled sheepishly, sealed the jade box, and kept it in the ring. It can store 100 medicines without losing its effectiveness.
Du Xiaoyu and Liu Yanran used storage bags, while the others used Najie.
Let’s practice here for a few days! I can't take away so much spiritual liquid.
Everyone had no choice but to practice cross-leggedly
Ye Chen practiced for two days this time and successfully broke through to the seventh level of the Body Tempering Realm. The Chaos Bead had enough spiritual liquid to absorb this time, and he was absorbing it non-stop. While everyone was practicing here, Ye Chen did not stop practicing. Ye Chen had insights from his previous life. There is no bottleneck in the realm commission. As long as there is energy, it can be improved. Ye Chen has no intention of stopping, and he is at full power.
Half a month later, Qin Mengyao and Li Yuanba were promoted to the Qi Refining Realm, Yu Yuanyang, Qin Yichen, and Liu Yanran reached the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm, and Ye Chen and Du Xiaoyu reached the eighth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
The Chaos Orb now has a radius of a hundred miles.
The spiritual liquid has dropped by more than half
Jade Yuanyang was smart and quickly guessed that Ye Chen was weird. Normally, everyone wouldn't be able to consume so much spiritual liquid during cultivation, so she asked privately, "Ye Chen, you have absorbed a lot of spiritual liquid, right?" "
Ye Chen was about to retort,
Jade Yuanyang whispered again, "You don't need to refute, and I won't tell anyone." He smiled mysteriously.
Ye Chen looked calm, unfazed by honor and disgrace, and did not explain any more. Several other people had puzzled faces, but no one said anything.
"Let's go, it's been more than half a month since we came out," Yu Yuanyang took the lead and said
Everyone exited the cave one after another. Liu Yanran followed Ye Chen closely.
Jade Yuanyang is pure and cute, and she also likes Ye Chen a little bit. After all, he is a little kid and doesn't have that much thought, but he is somewhat jealous.
Qin Mengyao is not surprised that she is still so cold and charming, the wind is light and the clouds are calm.
Liu Yanran is in "Dare to love, dare to hate", if you like it, you just like it, plus the hero saves the beauty, how can you not get into your heart?
After everyone walked carefully for two days, Ye Chen drank up the remaining four jars of wine.
I basically avoided the second-order monsters along the way, basically dealt with all the first-order monsters, and collected hundreds of first-order elixirs.
We are almost there. Let’s work harder and reach the entrance of the cave. Let’s take a rest tonight and recharge ourselves. We will enter the cave tomorrow.
The next day, everyone came to a canyon, filled with mist, and saw only two layers of cliffs towering into the clouds.
"Last time I ran for my life, I accidentally escaped into the fog. After about ten miles, I was blocked by something. Then I walked on the edge of the cliff. There was a cave not far away, and there was a huge stone blocking the entrance." DuXiaoyu explained the situation to everyone
